description: This file contains a series of shell test cases that verify the behavior of Git commands outside of a repository. It sets up environment variables, creates a non-repo directory, and runs various Git commands such as 'git diff', 'git grep', 'git apply', and others, checking their output and failure modes outside the context of an actual Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution with specified commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares contents of two files or inputs.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern in input and outputs matching lines.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.
